# AppointHive

> Booking, the live floor, and staff pay for barber shops and salons.

AppointHive is salon and barber shop software. Clients book online without creating an account. The shop runs one live queue for bookings and walk-ins. Commission and payslip PDFs come from the same visit record. Available as Hosted SaaS or a Standalone single-business license on infrastructure you control.

## Product facts

- Customers never create a login
- Multi-location booking supported
- Floor languages: English, Spanish, French
- Hosted: cloud subscription with trial
- Standalone: single-business license, does not phone home for license checks
- WhatsApp messaging only after a Meta-approved number
